name: Tax Filing Assistant
description: Prepare federal income taxes — PDF document ingestion, calculation, form generation, and guided filing. Federal returns only (no state). Supports 1040, Schedules 1/C/D/SE, Form 8889, Form 8863, and common credits. 2024 + 2025 tax years.
author: Crow

env_vars.name: CROW_TAX_DB_PATH
env_vars.description: Path to tax data database (defaults to Crow's main DB)

env_vars.name: CROW_TAX_ENCRYPTION_KEY
env_vars.description: Key that encrypts your saved returns and uploaded documents at rest. Crow generates it at install and saves it in Settings → Passwords (this machine only). Export the keychain to keep a copy: without the key, saved returns and documents can't be read on another machine. A reinstall takes it back from the keychain.

env_vars.name: CROW_TAX_ENCRYPTION_KEY_PREVIOUS
env_vars.description: Only after changing the passphrase: the old one, so returns saved with it can still be opened. Each return moves to the new passphrase when the tax server next starts or the return is saved; then this can be cleared.

notes: Federal returns only — no state income tax support. Supports MFJ, Single, HoH filing. 2025 tax year. Generates filled IRS PDFs ready to mail and step-by-step guided filing instructions. Saved returns and uploaded documents are encrypted at rest with a key Crow generates and keeps in Settings → Passwords; the figures read from documents (shown on the Documents tab) are stored unencrypted in Crow's database. Documents uploaded before tax 2.1.0 are encrypted when the dashboard next starts; plain copies may remain in earlier backups or on the disk until overwritten. Not a substitute for professional tax advice.
